images.title: Pair the ends
images.purpose: Show that pairs from the two ends of a run of consecutive numbers make the same total, with the middle number alone.
images.composition: Five boxes 41 to 45 with two arcs that pair 41 with 45 and 42 with 44, the middle 43 alone, and the sum 215.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A run of five consecutive numbers with arrows that pair the ends. FIVE BOXES in a row, each a rounded rectangle 150 by 150 px, y 300 to 450, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, at x 150 to 300, 360 to 510, 570 to 720, 780 to 930 and 990 to 1140, holding in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) the numbers 41, 42, 43, 44 and 45; the first, second, fourth and fifth are filled teal #0072B2 and the middle box (43) is filled reddish purple #CC79A7. OUTER ARC: a curved arrow in teal (5 px) above the boxes joining the top of the first box (x 225, y 300) and the top of the fifth box (x 1065, y 300), peaking at y 150, with the label 41 + 45 = 86 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px) centred at x 645, y 125. INNER ARC: a curved arrow in teal (5 px) joining the top of the second box (x 435, y 300) and the top of the fourth box (x 855, y 300), peaking at y 225, with the label 42 + 44 = 86 centred at x 645, y 205. Under the middle box, centred at x 645, y 505, the word middle in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). At the bottom, centred at x 728, y 650, the line 86 + 86 + 43 = 215 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than two arcs
an arc that joins any boxes other than 41 and 45, and 42 and 44
images.takeaway: Pairs from the two ends make the same total, so 41 + 42 + 43 + 44 + 45 = 86 + 86 + 43 = 215.
images.description: The run 41, 42, 43, 44, 45 with arcs joining 41 and 45 and 42 and 44, each pair marked 86, the middle 43 alone.
images.context: Concept image for Pairing the Ends of a Run, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at the two ends, then the next pair in, then the middle. The slip to watch: thinking the sum is 5 times the first number.

image_decisions.why: The arcs show the pairing, which is the whole method.
